name: CE_STATEMENT_LINES
description: CE_STATEMENT_LINES contains information about statement lines.

columns.name: STATEMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the bank statement line interface.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the parent bank statement row.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Statement Line number. It is automatically assigned and is  incremented by 1.

columns.name: TRX_CODE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to TRANSACTION_CODE_ID in CE_TRANSACTION_CODES.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE
columns.description: This is same as the one associated with TRX_CODE_ID in CE_TRANSACTION_CODES. Storing this column redundantly again along with TRX_CODE to reduce a simple join to CE_TRANSACTION_CODES every time (TRX_TYPE is used in many queries).

columns.name: FLOW_INDICATOR
columns.description: Stores the line amount flow direction that is, credit or debit. Possible values are CRDT and DBIT.

columns.name: RECON_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether a statement line is reconciled or not.

columns.name: SERVICER_STATUS
columns.description: Status of an entry on the books of an account servicer.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Statement line amount recorded in the bank statement.

columns.name: REVERSAL_IND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the entry is the result of a reversal operation.

columns.name: BOOKING_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when an entry is posted to an account and on the books of an account servicer.

columns.name: VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when assets become available to the account owner in a credit entry, or cease to be available to the account owner in a debit entry.

columns.name: ACCNT_SERVICER_REF
columns.description: Reference of the account servicing institution for the underlying transaction.

columns.name: COMM_WAIVER_IND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction is exempted from commission.

columns.name: TRX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: TRX_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Factor used for the conversion of amount from one currency to another. This reflects the price at which one currency was bought with another currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used in foreign exchange.

columns.name: CONTRACT_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the foreign exchange contract.

columns.name: ORIG_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: A depository financial institution. Data is reported for accounts held.

columns.name: ADDENDA_TXT
columns.description: Additional information on the entry details.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_REFERENCE
columns.description: Used by BAI2 format. Alphanumeric field defined by the originator.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of the bank statement transaction created in CE_EXTERNAL_TRANSACTIONS.

columns.name: INSTRUCTION_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party to unambiguously identify the instruction. The instruction identification is a point to point reference that can be used between the instructing party and the instructed party to refer the individual instruction. It can be included in several messages related to the instruction.

columns.name: END_TO_END_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unumbiguously identify the transaction. It is passed on unchanged, throughout the entire end to end chain.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the first instructing agent to unambiguously identify the transaction. It is passed on unchanged, throughout the entire interbank chain

columns.name: RECON_REFERENCE
columns.description: Reference to the underlying transaction information. Used for reconciliation.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Check number of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: CLEARING_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment instruction, assigned by the clearing system.

columns.name: RECON_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the reconciliation history information.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a reconciliation exception is found for the statement line.

columns.name: REVERSAL_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the statement line reversal reason.

columns.name: STRUCTURED_PAYMENT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Structured payment or receipt reference on bank statement line. Used for reconciliation.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
